represented_semantics.compactified_complex_spacetime: exact carrier of all complex two-dimensional subspace relations S of exact T=C4
represented_semantics.tautological_bundle: exact base/fiber incidence TAUT(S,t) iff S is a represented two-plane and t belongs to S
represented_semantics.quotient_bundle: for every S, an exact two-dimensional quotient package Q=T/S with surjective linear projection, kernel S, and coset equivalence
represented_semantics.tangent_bundle: for every quotient package, an exact carrier of all complex-linear maps S -> T/S
represented_semantics.klein_embedding: exact projective bijection from the two-plane carrier to the decomposable/Klein locus in P(Lambda^2 T)
represented_semantics.klein_relation: p01*p23 - p02*p13 + p03*p12 = 0, represented in basis convention f31=-f13
